tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Finds MCP servers, connectors, Agent Skills and Claude Code plugins for a product or task among ~92k AI agent tools. Returns ranked matches with type, category, GitHub stars, badges (first_party = made by the product's own maker, verified_publisher, live, free_to_try), install line and KitScout page

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Details and install or connect lines for one tool, by its exact name from search_tools: description, badges, stars, repo, how to install or connect (Claude Code command, Claude app connector steps), and for remote MCP servers the tools the server exposes (from the daily live check). An unknown name

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists all KitScout categories (id, name, group, tool count), to see what kinds of tools exist.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, check_tools · Public sink: search_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, check_tools · Public sink: search_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
